page.overview:
What is Arva Pars?

Arva Pars was an organization active during the Imperial Era. the group's leaders entered into negotiations with the Tagge Corporation over a sale. During the discussions, Arva Pars' leaders expressed their readiness to negotiate with the Tagge Corporation, which—the secretary of the Tagge Corporation's leader, Lady Domina Tagge—informed Domina of. In response, she told Lapin to not send a reply, expecting it to cause Arva Pars to question their offer before they reduced their asking price by twenty percent the following day.

Arva Pars was mentioned in flashbacks in the sixth issue of the 2020 comic series Star Wars: Doctor Aphra. The issue was written by Alyssa Wong and published by Marvel Comics
